title: Saturday 4 April 2026
headline: Key Developments in Financial Auditing and Disclosure Standards
intro: On 4 April 2026, significant updates emerged regarding the auditing of financial statements and the disclosure practices of financial market participants. The European Supervisory Authorities (ESAs) have reported increased efforts in transparency, particularly concerning principal adverse impacts. This briefing highlights the statutory audit's critical role…
summary: Statutory audits remain a cornerstone of financial oversight, ensuring that companies' financial statements are certified and reliable for stakeholders. These audits not only bolster investor confidence but also enhance the overall integrity of financial markets. The recent report from ESMA underscores the importance of these audits in maintaining accountability within public entities and private companies alike. In addition to auditing, the ESAs have noted a marked improvement in the voluntary disclosure of principal adverse impacts by financial market participants. This shift reflects a growing commitment to transparency and sustainability, aligning with the objectives of the Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation. The ESAs' fourth annual report highlights these advancements and sets a benchmark for future disclosures. Furthermore, the elaboration and issuance of Technical Standard…

sections.title: The Role of Statutory Audits
sections.body: Statutory audits are mandated reviews of financial records aimed at certifying the accuracy of companies' financial statements. These audits play a vital role in providing stakeholders, including investors and shareholders, with an independent opinion on the financial health of entities.
